guard: a retry skips a holder only when durable progress matches the exact registration op, frozen-gate revision, and current sorted holder set
why: The defect is not that a retry fails. It succeeds after repeating a holder verification that
the prior attempt already completed. The maintained cell therefore watches the exact retry call
list and the durable completed-before count, rather than accepting a merely reopened gate.
The smoke imports manager source directly but imports core through its package export, so the
command builds core before each run and after restore. This prevents a stale dist copy from
making the mutation invisible or leaving compiled mutant output behind.

mutations.name: retry ignores the durable completed set and re-verifies holder1
mutations.expectRed: retry skips only durable holder1 and verifies every remaining holder
mutations.cell: retry skips only durable holder1 and verifies every remaining holder
mutations.note: The cursor is still written and the gate still reopens. Only the resume behavior is removed.

mutations.name: the sibling and wildcard grant assertion disappears
mutations.find: check("the executor has no wildcard or sibling repair-key grant", !publish.includes(foreign) && !publish.some((row: string) => row.includes("eprepair") && row.includes(">")), publish);
mutations.expectRed: every cell ran (21 before the sentinel)
mutations.cell: every cell ran (21 before the sentinel)
mutations.note: Deleting one security assertion used to leave the suite green at 20/0. The sentinel must make that disappearing cell a named failure.
